import sand3d as s3d
import math


def business_laptop():
    base = base_part()
    lid_geometry = lid_part()
    screen = screen_part()
    fs = s3d.local(lid_geometry, 0, -1.5, 112.5)
    screen = s3d.at(screen, on=fs)
    lid = s3d.group("lid", lid_geometry, screen)
    f = s3d.local(base, 0, 108, 19, math.degrees(0.35), 0, 0)
    lid = s3d.at(lid, on=f)
    s3d.joint(
        "base_to_lid",
        lid,
        f,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-X",
        range=(-1.10 * 180 / math.pi, 0.55 * 180 / math.pi),
    )
    shutter = shutter_part()
    fw = s3d.local(lid, 0, 0, 204)
    shutter = s3d.at(shutter, on=fw)
    s3d.joint("lid_to_webcam_shutter", shutter, fw, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 14))
    keys = []
    for ri, y in enumerate((40, 4, -32)):
        for ci, x in enumerate((-115, -69, -23, 23, 69, 115)):
            name = f"key_r{ri}_c{ci}"
            k = key_part(name)
            fk = s3d.local(base, x + (0, 4, 8)[ri], y, 16)
            k = s3d.at(k, on=fk)
            s3d.joint(f"base_to_{name}", k, fk, kind="prismatic", axis="-Z", range=(0, 1.5))
            keys.append(k)
    return s3d.assembly("business_laptop", base, lid, shutter, *keys)


def base_part():
    a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bottom_shell", s3d.rect(320, 220), 4, both=True), z=2)
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("front_rim", s3d.rect(320, 4), 16, both=True), y=-108, z=8)
    c = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rear_rim", s3d.rect(320, 4), 16, both=True), y=108, z=8)
    d = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("left_rim", s3d.rect(4, 212), 16, both=True), x=-158, z=8)
    e = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("right_rim", s3d.rect(4, 212), 16, both=True), x=158, z=8)
    deck = s3d.extrude("deck_panel", s3d.rect(312, 212, r=10), 2, both=True)
    tools = []
    for ri, y in enumerate((40, 4, -32)):
        for ci, x in enumerate((-115, -69, -23, 23, 69, 115)):
            tools.append(
                s3d.at(
                    s3d.extrude("key_opening", s3d.rect(10, 10), 4, both=True),
                    x=x + (0, 4, 8)[ri],
                    y=y,
                )
            )
    deck = s3d.at(s3d.cut(deck, *tools), z=15)
    h = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("hinge_support", s3d.rect(220, 6), 2, both=True), y=108, z=15)
    pad = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("touchpad", s3d.rect(106, 70), 0.8, both=True), y=-68, z=16.4)
    for ob, col in (
        (a, "#303338"),
        (b, "#303338"),
        (c, "#303338"),
        (d, "#303338"),
        (e, "#303338"),
        (deck, "#212426"),
        (h, "#303338"),
        (pad, "#484a4f"),
    ):
        s3d.material(ob, "plastic", color=col)
    return s3d.group("base", a, b, c, d, e, deck, h, pad)


def lid_part():
    w = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("back_cover", s3d.rect(318, 215), 2, both=True), rx=90, y=-7, z=107.5)
    l = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("left_bezel", s3d.rect(12, 215), 8, both=True), rx=90, x=-153, y=-4, z=107.5
    )
    r = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("right_bezel", s3d.rect(12, 215), 8, both=True), rx=90, x=153, y=-4, z=107.5
    )
    t = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("top_bezel", s3d.rect(294, 14), 8, both=True), rx=90, y=-4, z=208)
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bottom_bezel", s3d.rect(294, 24), 8, both=True), rx=90, y=-4, z=12)
    cam = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("camera_strip", s3d.rect(28, 6), 2, both=True), rx=90, y=-1, z=204)
    barrel = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("hinge_barrel", s3d.circle(6), 220, both=True), ry=90)
    tab1 = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("left_hinge_tab", s3d.rect(32, 6), 8, both=True), x=-82, y=-1, z=5)
    tab2 = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("right_hinge_tab", s3d.rect(32, 6), 8, both=True), x=82, y=-1, z=5)
    for ob in (w, l, r, t, b, barrel, tab1, tab2):
        s3d.material(ob, "plastic", color="#303338")
    s3d.material(cam, "plastic", color="#050507")
    return s3d.group("lid_geometry", w, l, r, t, b, cam, barrel, tab1, tab2)


def screen_part():
    q = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("display_panel", s3d.rect(294, 177), 1.5, both=True), rx=90)
    s3d.material(q, "glass", color="#24333d", opacity=0.92)
    return s3d.group("screen_geometry", q)


def shutter_part():
    a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("shutter_plate", s3d.rect(18, 8), 1.2, both=True), rx=90, y=0.6)
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("shutter_tab", s3d.rect(4, 3), 3, both=True), x=6.5, y=1.5)
    s3d.material(a, "aluminium", color="#6b6e73")
    s3d.material(b, "aluminium", color="#6b6e73")
    return s3d.group("webcam_shutter", a, b)


def key_part(name):
    a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("keycap", s3d.rect(34, 30), 3, both=True), z=3.25)
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("plunger", s3d.rect(10, 10), 10, both=True), z=-2.5)
    s3d.material(a, "plastic", color="#121416")
    s3d.material(b, "plastic", color="#121416")
    return s3d.group(name, a, b)

import sand3d as s3d


def classroom_globe_on_meridian():
    pedestal = pedestal_part()
    mf = s3d.local(pedestal, 0, 0, 0)
    meridian = s3d.at(meridian_part(), on=mf)
    s3d.joint("meridian_tilt", meridian, mf, kind="revolute", axis="+X", range=(-40.107, 40.107))
    gf = s3d.local(meridian, 0, 0, 0)
    globe = s3d.at(globe_part(), on=gf)
    s3d.joint("globe_spin", globe, gf, kind="continuous", axis="+Z")
    f0 = s3d.local(pedestal, -325, 0, 0)
    k0 = s3d.at(side_knob_0_part(), on=f0)
    s3d.joint("knob_0_spin", k0, f0, kind="continuous", axis="+X")
    f1 = s3d.local(pedestal, 325, 0, 0)
    k1 = s3d.at(side_knob_1_part(), on=f1)
    s3d.joint("knob_1_spin", k1, f1, kind="continuous", axis="+X")
    return s3d.assembly("classroom_globe_on_meridian", pedestal, meridian, globe, k0, k1)


def pedestal_part():
    a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("weighted_base", s3d.circle(410), 40, both=True), z=-600)
    s3d.material(a, "brass", color="#73572e")
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("upright_post", s3d.circle(70), 330, both=True), z=-430)
    s3d.material(b, "brass", color="#bd8c40")
    c = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("lower_yoke_bar", s3d.circle(52), 560, both=True), z=-275, ry=90)
    s3d.material(c, "brass", color="#bd8c40")
    bits = [a, b, c]
    for x, suf in [(-286, "0"), (286, "1")]:
        arm = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("yoke_arm_" + suf, s3d.rect(38, 45), 335, both=True), x=x, z=-90)
        s3d.material(arm, "brass", color="#bd8c40")
        bits.append(arm)
        boss = s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("bearing_boss_" + suf, s3d.circle(110), 42, both=True), x=x, ry=90
        )
        s3d.material(boss, "brass", color="#bd8c40")
        bits.append(boss)
    return s3d.group("pedestal", *bits)


def meridian_part():
    ring = s3d.at(s3d.torus("meridian_band", 444, 16), rx=90)
    s3d.material(ring, "brass", color="#bd8c40")
    bits = [ring]
    for x, suf, sign in [(-246.5, "0", -1), (246.5, "1", 1)]:
        t = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("trunnion_" + suf, s3d.circle(36), 37, both=True), x=x, ry=90)
        s3d.material(t, "brass", color="#73572e")
        bits.append(t)
        f = s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("trunnion_flange_" + suf, s3d.circle(60), 10, both=True),
            x=sign * 228,
            ry=90,
        )
        s3d.material(f, "brass", color="#bd8c40")
        bits.append(f)
    for z, suf in [(212, "north"), (-212, "south")]:
        q = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(suf + "_socket", s3d.circle(48), 30, both=True), z=z)
        s3d.material(q, "brass", color="#73572e")
        bits.append(q)
    import math

    for i, deg in enumerate([-60, -30, 0, 30, 60]):
        ang = math.radians(deg)
        m = s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("degree_mark_" + str(i), s3d.rect(28, 6), 4, both=True),
            x=232 * math.cos(ang),
            y=-6,
            z=232 * math.sin(ang),
            ry=-deg,
        )
        s3d.material(m, "ceramic", color="#eadba3")
        bits.append(m)
    return s3d.group("meridian", *bits)


def globe_part():
    import math

    bits = []
    ob = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("ocean_sphere", 360), z=-180)
    s3d.material(ob, "plastic", color="#1452b8")
    bits.append(ob)
    for name, z in [("north_pin", 180), ("south_pin", -180)]:
        p = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(28), 34, both=True), z=z)
        s3d.material(p, "brass", color="#73572e")
        bits.append(p)
    q = s3d.torus("equator_grid", 364, 2.2)
    s3d.material(q, "ceramic", color="#eadba3")
    bits.append(q)
    for name, rx, ry in [("prime_meridian_grid", 90, 0), ("side_meridian_grid", 0, 90)]:
        q = s3d.at(s3d.torus(name, 364, 2), rx=rx, ry=ry)
        s3d.material(q, "ceramic", color="#eadba3")
        bits.append(q)
    for i, z in enumerate([-105, -55, 55, 105]):
        q = s3d.at(s3d.torus("latitude_grid_" + str(i), 2 * math.sqrt(181 * 181 - z * z), 1.6), z=z)
        s3d.material(q, "ceramic", color="#eadba3")
        bits.append(q)
    for i, (x, y, z, w, h, rz, col) in enumerate(
        [
            (-55, 166, 45, 70, 40, -0.30, "#1f7a33"),
            (45, 172, -30, 48, 76, 0.45, "#bd9c5c"),
            (82, -148, 58, 60, 32, 0.20, "#1f7a33"),
            (-90, -149, -50, 40, 32, -0.55, "#bd9c5c"),
        ]
    ):
        p = s3d.extrude("continent_" + str(i), s3d.ellipse(w, h), 1.6, both=True)
        p = s3d.at(p, x=x, y=y, z=z, rx=(-90 if y > 0 else 90), rz=math.degrees(rz))
        s3d.material(p, "plastic", color=col)
        bits.append(p)
    return s3d.group("globe", *bits)


def side_knob_0_part():
    o = s3d.at(s3d.knurl("side_knob_0", 58, 36), ry=90)
    o = s3d.at(o, x=-18)
    s3d.material(o, "plastic", color="#050505")
    return s3d.group("side_knob_0", o)


def side_knob_1_part():
    o = s3d.at(s3d.knurl("side_knob_1", 58, 36), ry=90)
    o = s3d.at(o, x=-18)
    s3d.material(o, "plastic", color="#050505")
    return s3d.group("side_knob_1", o)

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def desk_task_lamp():
    base = base_part()
    lower = lower_arm()
    f1 = s3d.local(base, -115, 0, 95, 0, -63, 0)
    lower = s3d.at(lower, on=f1)
    s3d.joint(
        "base_to_lower",
        lower,
        f1,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-0.55 * 180 / math.pi, 0.70 * 180 / math.pi),
    )
    upper = upper_arm()
    f2 = s3d.local(lower, 420, 0, 0, 0, 45, 0)
    upper = s3d.at(upper, on=f2)
    s3d.joint(
        "lower_to_upper",
        upper,
        f2,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-0.85 * 180 / math.pi, 0.85 * 180 / math.pi),
    )
    shade = shade_part()
    f3 = s3d.local(upper, 360, 0, 0, 0, 43, 0)
    shade = s3d.at(shade, on=f3)
    s3d.joint(
        "upper_to_shade",
        shade,
        f3,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-0.70 * 180 / math.pi, 0.70 * 180 / math.pi),
    )
    return s3d.assembly("desk_task_lamp", base, lower, upper, shade)


def base_part():
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("weighted_base", s3d.rect(340, 200, r=26), 35), "plastic", color="#0f1012"
    )
    b = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("pedestal_block", s3d.rect(80, 85), 18, both=True), "plastic", color="#0f1012"
    )
    b = s3d.at(b, x=-115, z=44)
    c = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("base_yoke_0", s3d.rect(55, 12), 95, both=True), "plastic", color="#0f1012"
    )
    c = s3d.at(c, x=-115, y=-66, z=82.5)
    d = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("base_yoke_1", s3d.rect(55, 12), 95, both=True), "plastic", color="#0f1012"
    )
    d = s3d.at(d, x=-115, y=66, z=82.5)
    e = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("base_hinge_pin", s3d.circle(16), 152, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    e = s3d.at(e, x=-115, z=95, rx=-90)
    feet = []
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate([(-122, -66), (-122, 66), (122, -66), (122, 66)]):
        q = s3d.material(
            s3d.extrude("rubber_foot_" + str(i), s3d.circle(36), 8, both=True),
            "rubber",
            color="#030304",
        )
        feet.append(s3d.at(q, x=x, y=y, z=-3.5))
    return s3d.group("base", a, b, c, d, e, *feet)


def lower_arm():
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("lower_hinge_barrel", s3d.circle(42), 98, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    a = s3d.at(a, rx=-90)
    rods = []
    for i, y in enumerate([-50, 50]):
        q = s3d.material(
            s3d.extrude("lower_rod_" + str(i), s3d.circle(18), 400, both=True),
            "aluminium",
            color="#8c9499",
        )
        rods.append(s3d.at(q, x=220, y=y, ry=90))
    pin = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("lower_elbow_pin", s3d.circle(17), 132, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    pin = s3d.at(pin, x=420, rx=-90)
    ks = []
    for i, y in enumerate([-55, 55]):
        q = s3d.material(
            s3d.extrude("lower_elbow_knuckle_" + str(i), s3d.circle(38), 30, both=True),
            "steel",
            color="#b8bdc2",
        )
        ks.append(s3d.at(q, x=420, y=y, rx=-90))
    return s3d.group("lower_arm", a, *rods, pin, *ks)


def upper_arm():
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("upper_hinge_barrel", s3d.circle(40), 64, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    a = s3d.at(a, rx=-90)
    rods = []
    for i, y in enumerate([-39, 39]):
        q = s3d.material(
            s3d.extrude("upper_rod_" + str(i), s3d.circle(16), 341, both=True),
            "aluminium",
            color="#8c9499",
        )
        rods.append(s3d.at(q, x=189.5, y=y, ry=90))
    pin = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("upper_wrist_pin", s3d.circle(15), 112, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    pin = s3d.at(pin, x=360, rx=-90)
    ks = []
    for i, y in enumerate([-47, 47]):
        q = s3d.material(
            s3d.extrude("upper_wrist_knuckle_" + str(i), s3d.circle(34), 26, both=True),
            "steel",
            color="#b8bdc2",
        )
        ks.append(s3d.at(q, x=360, y=y, rx=-90))
    return s3d.group("upper_arm", a, *rods, pin, *ks)


def shade_part():
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("shade_hinge_barrel", s3d.circle(38), 60, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    a = s3d.at(a, rx=-90)
    b = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("shade_neck", s3d.circle(34), 60, both=True), "plastic", color="#05332a"
    )
    b = s3d.at(b, x=48, ry=90)
    shell = s3d.revolve(
        "shade_shell",
        [(0, 0), (44, 0), (57, 30), (79, 105), (96, 180), (84, 170), (68, 108), (44, 34), (16, 0)],
    )
    shell = s3d.material(shell, "plastic", color="#05332a")
    shell = s3d.at(shell, ry=90, x=45)
    sock = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("bulb_socket", s3d.circle(52), 44, both=True), "steel", color="#b8bdc2"
    )
    sock = s3d.at(sock, x=75, ry=90)
    bulb = s3d.material(s3d.sphere("glowing_bulb", 64), "glass", color="#ffd76b", opacity=0.72)
    bulb = s3d.at(bulb, x=114, z=-32)
    return s3d.group("shade", a, b, shell, sock, bulb)
